description:
Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, System Engineering, or Computer Networks (or equivalent experience).
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in system administration, including Linux environments.
  • Solid understanding of computer networking.
  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and maintaining server hardware, network equipment, and physical IT infrastructure.
  • Solid understanding of information security principles and controls, including firewalls, antivirus, and vulnerability management.
  • Familiarity with system and network diagnostic and monitoring tools.
  • Upper-intermediate level of English.

︅︊︁︂︊︁︀︌︆︄︂︋︁︁︎︍︈︃︃︀︊︆︅︉︋︄︊︅︌️

Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, server hardware, software applications, and studio IT equipment.
  • Set up and manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls across systems and platforms.
  • Provide technical support to end-users, resolve hardware and software issues across Windows and macOS environments.
  • Occasionally onboard new employees, including account setup and hardware provisioning.
  • Manage IT assets and inventory.
  • Monitor system and network performance, availability, and reliability; proactively address issues before they impact users.
  • Perform regular system updates, patches, and upgrades to keep systems secure and up-to-date.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues in a timely manner.
  • Implement and manage information security controls, including firewalls, antivirus software, IDS/IPS system; participate in regular security audits and vulnerability assessments.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, changes, and troubleshooting guides; prepare regular reports on system performance and incidents.
  • Collaborate with other teams to support projects and initiatives, including system migrations, upgrades, and new deployments.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic working environment with opportunities for growth and development.
  • Collaboration with a professional and supportive team.
  • Meal tickets.
  • Private medical subscription.

📍 Location: Bucharest, District 6
🕓 Employment type: Full-time
